recentItems.title: He helped found Nunavut, now he’s fighting to age there
recentItems.description:
John Amagoalik is widely known as the ‘Father of Nunavut,’ but after a lifetime advocating for Inuit rights and self-determination he’s now fighting to age in the territory he helped create. CBC’s Juanita Taylor shares his story and explores how it has ignited a broader conversation about Nunavut’s reliance on southern facilities for elder care.

recentItems.title: How Yemen’s Houthis could supercharge global trade disruptions
recentItems.description:
Houthi rebels have taken control of Yemen’s Red Sea coastline and the strategic strait of Bab al-Mandeb, threatening to further destabilize global trade. For The National, CBC’s Margaret Evans breaks down the militia’s gains and how it could offer Iran more leverage in its war with the U.S.
